name: model-salt
description: Randomness from outside the model, so one prompt gives different answers that still do what you asked.
long_description: Ask a model for the same thing ten times and you often get the same answer ten times. Model Salt is a local MCP server with one tool, model_salt. Before a creative task the model calls it and gets back a few things to settle this time, such as a palette, a pose, a name or an opening line, and then does your request as you asked it. It runs on your machine, needs no keys and sends nothing anywhere.

tools.name: model_salt
tools.description: Call this once before you start any creative or open-ended request (a picture, an SVG, a story, a poem, an email, a design, a name, a plan, an approach to a problem).
